cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Believe This with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into treating your impossible explanation as the most useful version of events.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The office kettle's on strike. Help me negotiate before the clients arrive. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've filled it twice. It still won't boil.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then water isn't its grievance. Tell it we'll stop leaving it alone after meetings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can take it into the meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Give it my chair. A seat at the table should get us tea.

mechanism: A leads getting tea for clients and changes meeting arrangements to recruit B into treating a broken kettle as a striking colleague.
confusable: Unlike just accepting sentience, A needs B to negotiate and seat the kettle because the explanation supposedly solves the tea problem.
comparison: Workplace representation and A chair concession differ from guiding a migrating building.
seedUse: D151-b non-boiling kettle, meetings and chair; S02-b yields A place to preserve cooperation.
